row.title: EVIDENCE-RETURN-1: the executor ran later steps from the loop-evidence branch
row.body: scripts/executor_evidence.sh left the checkout on loop-evidence, so clock --chain and clock --heal ran that branch's old code and data and the wake cap from PR 727 never took effect. The script now returns to the commit it started on.
